tada.config.title: TADA Settings
tada.config.checkIntervalTicks.desc: How often the worn armor is checked and the effects are refreshed. 20 ticks = 1 second. Default 100 (5 s). Lower values react faster but cost a little more server time.
tada.config.effectDurationTicks.desc: How long each applied effect lasts. Default 320 (16 s). Minecraft blinks the HUD icon and flickers Night Vision when 200 ticks or less remain, so values below check interval + 201 are raised automatically on save.
tada.config.strengthLevelsPerPiece.desc: Strength levels added by each piece with a Strength trim (Bolt, Silence). Default 2: one piece gives Strength II, four pieces Strength VIII.
tada.config.strengthMaxLevel.desc: Upper limit for the stacked Strength level. Default 8 (Strength VIII). Maximum 255.
tada.config.onlyTadaArmor.desc: OFF: any trimmed armor (diamond, netherite, modded) gives the trim ability. ON: only Tadarite armor does. Default OFF.
tada.config.goldTrimCountsForPiglins.des: ON: a piece with a gold trim counts as golden armor, so piglins stay peaceful. Default ON.
tada.config.reset.desc: Set this value back to its default (%s). Applied when you press Done.
tada.config.lootChanceEndCity.desc: Chance that one finished TADA piece (enchanted, maybe trimmed and dyed) is added. Applies per chest, on top of the normal loot. 0% turns it off. Server-side setting; takes effect at once, also on already generated chests that were not opened yet.

tada.config.lootChanceOverworld.desc: Chance that one finished TADA piece (enchanted, maybe trimmed and dyed) is added. Applies per chest in dungeons, abandoned mineshafts, desert pyramids, jungle temples, strongholds, pillager outposts, ruined portals, igloos, big underwater ruins, armorer/weaponsmith/toolsmith village chests and the other bastion chests. 0% turns it off. Server-side setting.
tada.config.lootChanceFishing.desc: Chance that one finished TADA piece (enchanted, maybe trimmed and dyed) is added. Applies per treasure catch, and a treasure catch is rare in itself. 0% turns it off. Server-side setting; takes effect at once, also on already generated chests that were not opened yet.
tada.config.lootTrimChance.desc: Chance that a found TADA piece carries a trim. The pattern is random among those that have an ability. Server-side setting.
tada.config.lootDyeChance.desc: Chance that a found TADA piece is dyed in one or two random colors. Server-side setting.
tada.config.lootEnchantLevelsMin.desc: Lowest enchanting-table level used to enchant a found piece. Server-side setting.
tada.config.lootEnchantLevelsMax.desc: Highest enchanting-table level used to enchant a found piece. If lower than the minimum, the minimum is used. Server-side setting.
tada.config.traderTemplateChance.desc: Chance that a wandering trader offers a random armor trim template that has an ability, for 24 emeralds and 2 diamonds. Rolled once when he spawns, so it does not affect traders that already exist. 0% turns it off. Server-side setting.
tada.config.traderArmorChance.desc: Chance that a wandering trader offers a finished TADA piece (enchanted, maybe trimmed and dyed) for 64 emeralds and 8 diamonds. Rolled once when he spawns. 0% turns it off. Server-side setting.
